headline: Zenith Exports files SEBI Regulation 74(5) compliance certificate for September quarter
summary: Zenith Exports has submitted its compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September. This is a routine regulatory filing confirming dematerialisation and rematerialisation of share certificates. Retail investors should note this is a mandatory procedural update without financial impact.
why_it_matters: No financial impact, routine regulatory paperwork.
